# Part IV: Working in a Team {.unnumbered .part}

Part III made the outputs on one person's computer. Work is rarely like that: a change goes to
colleagues for review, the build has to work on machines other than yours, and the data, the
tools and the network belong to an organisation with rules of its own. This part takes the
Acme project there, in two chapters.

**@sec-team, Pull Requests and Builds You Can Trust.** Rules for a team's agents in
`AGENTS.md`, a pull request template with the three checks, and continuous integration: a
check that rebuilds the project on every pull request, publishing from `main`, and the monthly
reports rendered on a schedule.

**@sec-at-work, At Work and in a Start-up.** What leaves your computer when an agent works and
what each kind of plan does with it, confidential data, approved tools and locked-down
machines, proxies, house templates, and what a start-up should build this way.

The first chapter continues the repository from checkpoint 19 and ends at checkpoint 20; the
second is reading, with no new files.
